subject: Performance amplification roadmap (confidential) — Dylan Brooks
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Performance amplification roadmap (confidential) — Dylan Brooks

Team —

I wanted to surface rising concerns about Dylan's recent performance and propose a short, documented coaching roadmap we can align on before escalating further. This is confidential HR coordination only at this stage; I will not loop Dylan until we have alignment on expectations and cadence.

What I've observed (examples attached in evidence-summary-dbrooks.pdf):
- Repeated missed delivery dates on three customer-facing tickets in March/April; tickets #CS-4531, #CS-4620, #CS-4687 with inconsistent root-cause analysis.
- Two instances of incomplete handoffs that required leadership rework, which increased customer SLA risk.
- Drop in responsiveness to async requests (measured across Slack threads) compared to Q1 baseline.

Proposed confidential coaching roadmap (10 business days -> review -> extend if needed):
1) Outcome focus: pick 2 measurable goals tied to customer impact — one delivery metric (on-time completion rate) and one quality metric (post-release defects).
2) Artifacts: weekly written status (template attached: coaching-checklist-template.docx) and a short evidence log (email/PR links).
3) Check-ins: weekly 30-min 1:1 with me + HR check after week 2 (calendar-invite attached).
4) Support: identify blocking training / pairing opportunities (I can assign a senior peer for pairing on deliveries).
5) Escalation: if no measurable progress by checkpoint 3 (30 calendar days), we will consider formal next steps with HR.

Ask of HR: please review wording and mandatory documentation requirements. Anything legally required that I should include in the first coaching meeting notes? Please propose any edits to the timeline or wording to ensure we stay compliant.

I am attaching: evidence-summary-dbrooks.pdf (examples), a blank coaching-checklist-template.docx, and a draft calendar placeholder.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Performance amplification roadmap (confidential) — Dylan Brooks

Laura —

Thanks for the detailed summary and for keeping this controlled. I've reviewed the evidence PDF and the flow looks reasonable. A few HR notes before you meet with Dylan:

- Avoid using the word "PIP" in the initial coaching messaging. Use "focused development roadmap" and "performance expectations".
- Ensure each weekly status includes specific, time-bound success criteria (e.g., "complete X by EOD Friday, test coverage >= 80% for the change").
- Document every 1:1 with a brief bullet list and attach the evidence links. HR will retain a copy in the case file.
- If you opt for a 1:1 with HR present, let me know — otherwise HR can review the notes after the conversation.

I've attached HR-case-template.pdf with the minimum items we require for escalation if things don't improve. For compliance: include dates, the business impact, and the support offered (pairing/training).

Suggested edits to your plan: make the first checkpoint at 10 business days (to collect a minimum two weekly updates) and a formal HR review at day 15. If you want, I can draft the manager-facing language for the coaching kickoff; see the short boilerplate below you can use in the 1:1:

"We want to set clear expectations and support you with a focused development roadmap. Over the next 30 days we will track two measurable goals, meet weekly for 30 minutes, and document progress. This is to help you get back to the expected performance level. HR is here to support the process."

If you want me in the kickoff on Tuesday at 10:00, I can join.

—Monica
Monica Patel
HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-23T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Performance amplification roadmap (confidential) — Dylan Brooks

Laura/Monica —

I reviewed the evidence and Monica's suggested edits — you have my support to proceed. A couple of additions from a leadership perspective:

- Define the success metrics explicitly in the kickoff email (e.g., "reduce reopen rate on assigned tickets to <5% within 30 days"; "achieve on-time delivery on sprint stories at >=85%").
- Capture one example of acceptable vs. unacceptable work for each metric (helps calibration during review).
- If progress stalls, consider whether a temporary role adjustment (reduce customer-facing ownership for 30 days) will remove noise and allow focused skill rebuilding. That option should be offered before initiating any formal performance plan.

I can attend the week-3 review if useful. Please keep me copied on the summary notes after each checkpoint.

Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-24T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: 1:1 follow-up & development roadmap

Dylan —

Thanks for carving time today. I wanted to follow up with the development roadmap we discussed in our 1:1 and share the first set of expectations so you have a clear picture of the next 30 days. This note is to make sure we are aligned and to provide support resources.

Goals (measurable):
- Delivery: Complete assigned customer tickets within the SLA window for the next 4 sprints (target: >=85% on-time).
- Quality: Reduce post-release defects tied to your changes to fewer than 2 incidents over the next 30 days.

Support I will provide:
- Weekly 30-min 1:1 with focused agenda (progress, blockers, evidence links).
- Pairing sessions with a senior peer on Fridays (2 hours).
- Access to asynchronous troubleshooting notes and a short training module on release checklists.

Documentation: please fill out the attached coaching checklist after each week and include links to PRs, ticket updates, and brief notes on what changed.

Checkpoints:
- Week 1 (2027-04-30): initial review (status + evidence submitted).
- Week 2 (2027-05-07): HR informal check-in.
- Week 3 (2027-05-14): leadership review.

If we see measurable progress, we will continue to support and close the roadmap. If not, HR will advise on next steps. My goal is to help you get back on track — I value the work you've done here and want to see you succeed.

Please reply to confirm you received this and to confirm the Friday pairing time works for you.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
